method: Official Google Play app detail pages fetched sequentially without authentication. Public SoftwareApplication JSON-LD supplied names, developers, icons and short summaries. Search and related-app links supplied discovery. No ratings, review counts or prices imported.
limitations: A curated, incomplete catalog. Discovery used eight ranked English Google Play searches with gl=US plus official-domain web searches; it does not enumerate every store listing. Reachability does not guarantee availability in other countries, device compatibility, ongoing maintenance, or the accuracy of publisher feature claims. Ratings, review counts and prices are not imported. Listing names can differ by locale.
